authorization: Latest user supplement overrides conflicting original MOT-QA task requirements.
current_action: Prepare human appearance review and audit tracker documentation; stop before any QA generation.

source_scope.MOT17: each train sequence frames floor(N/2)+1..N; original timestamps retained
source_scope.tracker_train_tune_overlap: requires selected complete detector/association/ReID pipeline audit

appearance_shortage_fallback: transfer all shortage to box; no additional model-generated descriptions

reference_box.cover_definition: maximum intersection / target-box area over another GT person, matching Stage 2 appearance supplement
reference_box.coordinate_definition: clipped continuous xyxy pixel edges divided by frame width,height; retain raw GT box in evidence
reference_box.text_template: the person marked with the red box at {t_ref_s:.3f} s
reference_box.evaluation_implementation: later stage; add one labeled reference image after video frames and state its timestamp

target_identity_reuse.scope: all reference types and operations combined; count every explicitly targeted person

additional_group.reason: Include in collapsed section to apply final user-pass-only instruction also to the 17 previously agent-cleared phrases.

appearance_review.phrase_policy: review exact original text; notes do not automatically rewrite or approve another phrase

sports_dataset_gate.denominator: all 40 selected rows, including fail and uncertain
sports_dataset_gate.below_threshold: disable ALL SportsMOT appearance references; use box instead
sports_dataset_gate.above_threshold: only individually user-passed reviewed descriptions; no extrapolation to unreviewed rows

appearance_review.scope_of_pass: specific phrase + sequence + target + verified reference frame; no interval-wide extrapolation
appearance_review.start_generation_gate: wait for user-uploaded exported result; unresolved or unreviewed phrases never count as passed

MOT17.O3_allowed: only same-ID internal gaps classified as occlusion followed by reappearance; no frame-exit return questions
MOT17.O3_forbidden: questions whether a person returns after leaving the frame
MOT17.O4_allowed: window-local count of ID first appearances/entries, without same-person second entry within the window
MOT17.O4_conservative_window_policy: exclude a counting window with observed exits/re-entry ambiguity; do not label different IDs as different natural persons across exit/re-entry

SportsMOT.reason: GT retains occluded people; disappearance cause strongly predicts dataset source

DanceTrack.O3_exit_return_precheck: inspect all same-sequence exit and new-ID first-appearance events for spatial/time ambiguity before generating each out-of-view-return item; retain evidence
DanceTrack.conservative_policy: without an independent natural-person re-entry guarantee, keep exit/return items identity_risk=true even if no obvious conflicting new ID is found

answer_balance.scope: class letter, semantic yes/no, count/time bins and ordering as appropriate; do not hide semantic skew by only permuting letters

unchanged_stage3_requirements.language: English, no GT ID in questions
unchanged_stage3_requirements.appearance_similarity_model: select and document public feature model before eventual generation; not needed or run for this review preparation
unchanged_stage3_requirements.templates_and_additional_implementation_: lock separately before generating any QA; this file freezes the user-specified constraints now

stage3_manual_question_review.export_style: same local HTML radio choices, notes and JSON export as reference review

current_prohibitions: no QA generation until user review upload
pre_generation_revision_reason: Remove unintended censored-absence allowance to match the user restriction exactly; no QA generated.
